summary: Backend-only testing for Rakan 5000 account routing logic. All 10 pytest tests PASSED + 5 curl verification tests PASSED. Features working correctly: 1) Operations with 5000 account code route to Rakan Parts scope, 2) Non-5000 accounts fall back to workshop flow even with RAKAN_PARTS_OPERATION kind, 3) Journal entries filter out Rakan by default and include when include_rakan=true, 4) Chart of accounts returns valid codes (no malformed UUIDs), 5) Reset endpoint works without crash.

✅ DELETE /api/accounts-chart/reset stable after multiple calls (no crash)
✅ GET /api/finance/chart-of-accounts returns success=True with valid structure
✅ Chart of accounts contains required account types (asset, liability, etc.)
✅ POST /api/operations with accountingAccountId=5000 → routes to scope=rakan_parts, businessUnit=rakan_parts
✅ POST /api/operations with non-5000 account + operationKind=RAKAN_PARTS_OPERATION → routes to scope=workshop
✅ Operations with 5000 account create journal entries with source=operation_rakan_parts
✅ GET /api/finance/journal-entries without include_rakan excludes Rakan entries (0 found)
✅ GET /api/accounts-chart returns accounts list with valid structure
✅ No malformed UUID account codes in chart of accounts (49 accounts all valid)
